correctness.rationale: Spectral decomposition of multipartite L has modes 0, N−a_j, N with exact vertex-projection masses. M-matrix inverse gives positive offdiagonal of C=2R−I; rational R_b(s)-R_c(s) has sign b−c, so smallest parts control. The minimum diagonal numerator 1+as−(N−a)(N−2)s² has unique positive root; strict R_a decreasing and uniform stationary limit prove no second window. Independent symbolic root evaluation and exact rational matrix inversions for five positive part profiles verified crossing, offdiagonal positivity and critical part; general theorem follows from algebra, not finite checks.
